{{Short description|Taiwanese chemist}}
'''Shie-Ming Peng''' ({{zh|t=彭旭明}}; born 2 March 1949) is a Taiwanese chemist.

Peng attended [[National Hsinchu Senior High School]] and graduated from [[National Taiwan University]] prior to completing a doctorate from the [[University of Chicago]]. He returned to teach at NTU in 1976, after two years as a postdoctoral researcher at [[Northwestern University]]. Peng was granted a [[Humboldt Fellowship]] in 1983, elected a member of [[Academia Sinica]] in 1998, and became a [[Fellow of the Royal Society of Chemistry]] in 2009.<ref>{{cite news |title=Peng, Shie-Ming |url=https://www.ch.ntu.edu.tw/english/faculty/?id=smpeng&lang=en |accessdate=2 December 2018 |publisher=National Taiwan University}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Shie-Ming Peng |url=https://academicians.sinica.edu.tw/index.php?r=academician-n%2Fshow&id=214 |access-date=10 September 2023 |publisher=Academia Sinica}}</ref> In 2016, Peng became a laureate of the [[Asian Scientist 100]] by the ''[[Asian Scientist]]''.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.asianscientist.com/as100/ |title=The Asian Scientist 100 |author= <!--Not stated--> |date= |website= |publisher= [[Asian Scientist]] |access-date= 13 March 2025 |quote= |language= }}</ref>
